The CRD tenants.minio.min.io under crds/ changed (the file was removed). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
Chart default `console.image.tag` changed from `v0.17.1` to `v0.17.2` and the rendered objects differ.
Chart default `operator.image.tag` changed from `v4.4.20` to `v4.4.21` and the rendered objects differ.
The pod template of Deployment/stageproof-check/console changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=operator].image. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.
The pod template of Deployment/stageproof-check/minio-operator changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=operator].image. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.
